results.title: Patlabor EZY File 1
results.original_title: 機動警察パトレイバー EZY File 1
results.overview: The first of a 3-part theatrical series taking place in 2036, 38 years after the events of Patlabor on Television and The New Files.

results.title: Septum
results.overview: On the day after Halloween, a college film student encounters a stranger and plays a game of rock-paper-scissors. Then they transform into multiple personas while pondering their own personal experiences and relationships.

results.title: The Metropolitan Opera: Macbeth
results.overview: Two of opera’s most extraordinary artists return to The Met: Live in HD for Verdi’s thrilling take on the immortal Shakespearean tale of the scheming couple determined to seize power at any cost. Following past triumphs in many of Verdi’s signature baritone roles, Quinn Kelsey is the Scottish king haunted by the ghosts of his murderous ascent to the throne, opposite Lise Davidsen—the world’s reigning dramatic soprano—as the power-mad Lady Macbeth, whose ruinous ambition damns them both. Met Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin takes the podium for a penetrating production by Louisa Proske, a brilliant young director making waves around the world. Rounding out the all-star cast are tenor Freddie De Tommaso as the heroic Macduff and bass-baritone Ryan Speedo Green as Macbeth’s friend-turned-victim Banquo. This live cinema transmission is part of The Met: Live in HD series, bringing opera to movie theaters across the globe.

results.title: Two Chairs
results.overview: The documentary will feature interviews with contemporary theorists and practitioners who will share their insights on the concept of a chair.

results.title: A Woman Today
results.overview: The life of a young woman is turned upside down after a violent assault, making her realize the fragility of her freedom.

results.title: RISE
results.overview: The year is 2099. With the evolution of AI bringing machines to a superior to human intelligence they have lived peacefully and in harmony together. Until now…

results.title: The Wrong Baby Daddy
results.overview: Lila’s life finally feels complete when she starts a dream job with her close friend Robin, falls into a promising romance with Mark, and discovers she’s pregnant. But everything shifts when Julia, Mark’s ex-wife, reappears the moment she learns about the baby. At first, Julia’s involvement seems harmless, even polite, until she begins showing up uninvited, inserting herself into every corner of Lila’s new life. As Julia’s presence grows more intrusive and her intentions more unsettling, Lila realizes she may be fighting to protect far more than just her future. Soon, what began as a perfect new chapter becomes a tense battle of boundaries, obsession, and survival.

results.title: Hands
results.overview: In a world of elite underground fighters, a couple tries to prove they are the best against a greedy rival and a merciless hired gun. They soon have to choose between winning and vengeance.

results.title: Lemonade
results.overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

results.title: Family Fears Another Night of Terror
results.original_title: Familia teme enfrentar una nueva noche de terror
results.overview: Every night, a family of four faces the terror of living in a haunted house. Except the house is not really a house, but a television set where darkness reigns instead of walls. If existence is merely a grotesque performance, who is hiding behind the camera?

results.title: Arulvaan
results.overview: Follows Muthuvel, a resolute collector who overcomes all obstacles to educate a tribal girl and provide school access for the entire forest community.

results.title: Plain Folks
results.overview: A Pakistani immigrant college freshman is excited to attend her first real college party, despite her fish-out-of-water status on the white, conservative, mostly Mormon campus, but a supernatural force with ties to the school has other plans for her.

results.title: Doll of Deceit
results.overview: A woman's affair with a hired handyman takes a dark turn when her husband discovers the betrayal, leading to a suspenseful tale of captivity and an eerie transformation that blurs the line between reality and nightmare. Who will survive?

results.title: Crossing
results.overview: A retelling of the Red Army crossing the Chishui River four times to outmaneuver 400,000 enemy troops.

results.title: Almari
results.overview: When a family discovers the enchanting powers of their old mysterious cupboard, their lives spiral into a web of desires, drawing both - foes and vices to their doorstep.

results.title: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
results.original_title: Best Served Cold: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
results.overview: When a suspect in a forgery case is murdered and the prosecutor goes missing, Hannah and Chad must uncover how the two cases are connected and solve them in time for the trial.

results.title: Cool Books
results.overview: Hilario is a frustrated 40-year-old writer, trapped between nostalgia for classic literature and cynicism about the contemporary publishing world. While his novel is rejected by all Spanish publishers, he makes a living selling books at the bookstore La Ménsula and teaching an online writing workshop for older ladies, although his caustic attitude and disdain for sentimental stories only serve to alienate them.

results.title: Most Likely
results.overview: Shy high schooler Henry and outgoing friend Max attend Model UN in 1990s New York. Amid tensions and uncertainties, Henry connects deeply with Lucy, reconciling with Max and gaining confidence.
